title: Wi-Fi temperature logger
desc: Read temperature and humidity and show them on a small web page served by the board itself.

title: Line-following robot
needs: Arduino, 2 motors, motor driver, IR sensors
desc: A two-wheeled car that follows black tape. A classic first robot that teaches sensors and control loops.

title: Plant watering reminder
desc: Light an LED or send a message when the soil gets dry. Capacitive sensors last longer than the bare-metal resistive kind.

title: Pan-tilt camera mount
needs: 2 hobby servos, joystick or web page
desc: Drive two servos to aim a camera. Power the servos from their own supply, not from a pin on the board.

title: Obstacle-avoiding rover
needs: Chassis kit, ultrasonic sensor, motor driver
desc: Drive forward, measure distance, and turn away from walls. Then add smoother behaviour with a simple state machine.
